answer: The oasis schedule is applied in meadow and nectar exposes each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4902 identities would post 3019 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
